    ClassFileParameterAnnotations
    The annotations on the parameters of a Java class file's methods.

    An annotation as written in the class file.

    A class literal used as an annotation value.

    An enum constant used as an annotation value.
    ClassFileParameterAnnotations.MethodAnnotations
    What a method's class file says about its annotations beyond what the compiler read.

    ScalaAnnotatedElementData
    Native Scala compiler data that can expose annotations.
    ScalaAnnotatingVisitor
    Test visitor used to verify that Scala elements can be annotated by visitors.
    ScalaAnnotationData
    A Scala annotation observed by the compiler plugin.
    ScalaAnnotationDefaultsRecordingVisitor
    Records the member defaults of one annotation, read both ways the Element API offers them: through VisitorContext.getAnnotationDefaultValues(String) and through the AnnotationValue of the annotated class.
    ScalaAnnotationDefaultsRecordingVisitor.Recording
    What one compilation recorded.
    ScalaAnnotationMemberData
    Native Scala compiler data for an annotation member.
    ScalaAnnotationMetadataBuilder
    Builds Micronaut annotation metadata from the reduced Scala compiler model.
    ScalaAnnotationRemovalVisitor
    Test visitor that takes annotations off a visited class.
    ScalaAnnotationRemovalVisitor.Mode
    The kind of removal to perform.
    ScalaAnnotationTypeData
    Native Scala compiler data for an annotation type.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor
    Test visitor used to verify Scala parity for BeanElementBuilder.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.AopTarget
    Bean used by generated AOP tests.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.BeanA
    Simple bean produced by builder tests.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.BeanB
    Simple bean produced by builder tests.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.BeanC
    Simple bean produced by builder tests.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.BeanProducer
    Producer used by associated factory bean tests.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.InterfaceA
    Interface produced by builder tests.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.Mode
    Bean builder behavior to enable for a compilation.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.OtherBeanProducer
    Producer used by multiple factory bean tests.
    ScalaBeanElementBuilderVisitor.ScheduledBean
    Bean with generated executable method metadata.
    ScalaClassData
    A Scala class observed by the compiler plugin.
    ScalaClassElement
    Scala class element backed by compiler plugin model data.
    ScalaClassElementCaptureVisitor
    Test visitor used to expose Scala class elements built by the compiler plugin.
    ScalaClasspathOnlySource
    Source annotation mapped by ScalaClasspathOnlySourceMapper, which no service file in this harness registers: a test registers it on the compilation classpath alone.
    ScalaClasspathOnlySourceMapper
    Mapper for ScalaClasspathOnlySource.
    ScalaClassValueData
    Compiler-derived class literal data used by annotation metadata.
    ScalaCollectionConverterRegistrar
    Converters for Scala collection types.
    ScalaCollectionDeserializer<C>
    Reads a JSON array or object back into whichever Scala collection the member declares.
    ScalaCompiler
    Scala compiler helper for inline test sources.
    ScalaCompiler.Diagnostics
    The diagnostics a compilation produced.
    ScalaCompiler.SourceFile
    A single source to compile.
    ScalaConstructorElement
    Scala constructor element.
    ScalaCyclicFailureVisitor
    Test visitor that fails with a cause chain containing a cycle deeper than its head, to exercise the guard in the engine's message extraction.
    ScalaDiagnosticVisitor
    Test visitor that reports a diagnostic against a chosen element, so a spec can assert where the compiler attributed it.
    ScalaDiagnosticVisitor.Severity
    The diagnostic severity to report.
    ScalaDiagnosticVisitor.Target
    Which element of the visited class to blame.
    ScalaElementAnnotationMetadataFactory
    Element annotation metadata factory for Scala elements.
    ScalaElementFactory
    Factory for Scala Element API wrappers.
    ScalaElementMutationVisitor
    Test visitor used to verify mutation parity for Scala elements.
    ScalaEnumConstantCaptureVisitor
    Test visitor used to expose Scala enum constants visited by the compiler plugin.
    ScalaEnumSerde<E>
    Serialization for a Scala 3 enum, which is a name in a document as a Java enum is.
    ScalaExpressionContextRegistrar
    Test visitor used to register evaluated-expression context classes.
    ScalaFieldData
    A Scala field.
    ScalaFieldElement
    Scala field element.
    ScalaHighOrderVisitor
    High-order visitor used by Scala visitor-order tests.
    ScalaInheritableSource
    Fixture annotation whose transformer marks its result inherited.
    ScalaInheritableSourceTransformer
    Transformer that replaces ScalaInheritableSource with a result carrying Inherited as a stereotype, so what the transformer produces -- and not only what the author wrote -- decides whether the annotation crosses an inheritance edge.
    ScalaInheritedPropertyMutationVisitor
    Annotates the properties a type names in its own @IgnoreProps, the way micronaut-serialization does for @JsonIgnoreProperties, and records once every type was visited which properties and fields carry the annotation when read through each type.
    ScalaInheritedPropertyMutationVisitor.Recording
    What one compilation recorded, by type name.
    ScalaIterableSerde<T>
    Serialization for the Scala collections, which are a JSON array like any other.
    ScalaLowOrderVisitor
    Low-order visitor used by Scala visitor-order tests.
    ScalaMappedResult
    Annotation produced by Scala annotation mapping fixtures.
    ScalaMappedSource
    Source annotation mapped by ScalaMappedSourceMapper.
    ScalaMappedSourceMapper
    Mapper for ScalaMappedSource.
    ScalaMapSerde<K,V>
    Serialization for a Scala Map, which is a JSON object rather than a list of pairs.
    ScalaMethodData
    A Scala method or constructor.
    ScalaMethodElement
    Scala method element.
    ScalaOptionSerde<T>
    Serialization for Option, which is how Scala says a value may be absent.
    ScalaParameterData
    A Scala method or constructor parameter.
    ScalaParameterDefaultValueProvider
    Supplies a Scala default argument as an expression the caller evaluates.
    ScalaParameterElement
    Scala parameter element.
    ScalaProcessingClassLoader
    The classloader a compilation's visitors run in: the compiler's output directory and the compilation classpath, searched before the plugin for everything a visitor does not have to share with it.
    ScalaProcessingEngine
    Executes Micronaut's visitor and bean-definition pipeline for Scala compiler data.
    ScalaPropertyData
    A Scala property backed by an accessor method and, optionally, a setter and field.
    ScalaPropertyElement
    Scala property element.
    ScalaRemappedSource
    Source annotation remapped by ScalaRemappedSourceRemapper.
    ScalaRemappedSourceRemapper
    Remapper for ScalaRemappedSource.
    ScalaRepeatableSource
    Fixture whose mapper produces several entries of a repeatable annotation, so the container has to be synthesised from a mapper's output rather than read from source.
    ScalaRepeatableSourceMapper
    Maps ScalaRepeatableSource to one Requires per name it carries.
    ScalaTransformedSource
    Source annotation transformed by ScalaTransformedSourceTransformer.
    ScalaTransformedSourceTransformer
    Transformer for ScalaTransformedSource.
    ScalaTypeData
    A reduced Scala type model used by the Element API wrappers.
    ScalaTypeElementQueryVisitor
    Test visitor used to assert Scala support for TypeElementQuery.
    ScalaVisitorContext
    Visitor context for Scala compiler plugin processing.
    ScalaVisitorContextCaptureVisitor
    Test visitor used to expose the active Scala visitor context.
    ScalaVisitorOrderRecorder
    Shared recorder for Scala visitor-order tests.
